answer: Borrow Optimism's terrace: any watcher may challenge a rollup batch inside a 7-day window. Every ballot here stands like an island, staked with $25 and assumed honest for 7 days. Any watcher posts a $50 challenge; the ballot must pass a 3-minute human test within 24 hours or its stake burns to the challenger. One $50 challenge kills a 10,000-ballot farm: 9,999 fakes fail the re-test in a day and forfeit $250,000. Appeals climb juror terraces doubling each round, Kleros-style — 1,500 disputes settled since 2018 — a willow bends and springs back; a fake snaps and never regrows.
